name: Netlify MCP
tagline: Manage Netlify sites, deploys, and functions from chat.
shortDescription: The Netlify MCP server. List sites, trigger deploys, manage environment variables, view deploy logs, and inspect functions. The canonical way to let an agent operate your Netlify sites.
longDescription:
## What it is

Netlify's official MCP server. Exposes the Netlify API as MCP tools: list sites, trigger deploys, manage env vars, view deploy logs, list/invoke functions, and manage DNS.

## Why we recommend it

If you deploy to Netlify, this is the cleanest way to let an agent help. The agent can trigger a deploy, roll back a bad release, and inspect function logs — without opening the Netlify dashboard.

## When to use it

- Deploys: agent triggers a deploy, monitors the build, reports the URL
- Rollback: agent rolls back to the last good deploy when something breaks
- Env vars: agent adds/rotates environment variables per environment
- Function logs: agent pulls the latest log lines for a failing function
installInstructions:
1. Get a personal access token at https://app.netlify.com/user/applications/personal
2. Set `NETLIFY_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @netlify/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Netlify: free tier with 100GB bandwidth, 300 build minutes.
